baseVariables.name: base-rem
baseVariables.usage: Global sizing unit bridged by --stv-rem (ms parity). Set once to scale every KeenMate component together; 10px fallback.

baseVariables.name: base-accent-color
baseVariables.usage: Primary accent — selection, checked checkbox, drop-zones, focus rings, debug panel. Tints derived via color-mix().

baseVariables.name: base-accent-color-hover
baseVariables.usage: Accent hover step — checked-checkbox hover (ms parity).

baseVariables.name: base-accent-color-active
baseVariables.usage: Accent active/pressed step.

baseVariables.name: base-success-color
baseVariables.usage: Success hue (drop-valid border, dragover highlight). The colour itself, per pure-admin canonical (`base-text-on-success` is the on-surface text).

baseVariables.name: base-danger-color
baseVariables.usage: Danger hue (drop-invalid border, danger context-menu items, scroll-highlight arrows).

baseVariables.name: base-main-bg
baseVariables.usage: Tree surface + the color-mix base for the neutral hover surface; also --stv-light (elevated chip / debug stats). Light fallback uses light-dark().

baseVariables.name: base-elevated-bg
baseVariables.usage: Elevated surface for context-menu (via dropdown chain) and --stv-elevated-bg. Light fallback uses light-dark().

baseVariables.name: base-border-color
baseVariables.usage: Default border color (--stv-border: borders + spinner track).

baseVariables.name: base-hover-bg
baseVariables.usage: NEUTRAL hover surface (ms --ms-primary-bg parity) — node rows AND context-menu items. NOT an accent tint; accent is reserved for selection.

baseVariables.name: base-active-bg
baseVariables.usage: Stronger neutral active/pressed surface (--stv-primary-bg-hover).

baseVariables.name: base-text-color-1
baseVariables.usage: Primary body text (node labels, context-menu items).

baseVariables.name: base-text-color-2
baseVariables.usage: Secondary text (reserved tier; exposed for cross-component parity).

baseVariables.name: base-text-color-3
baseVariables.usage: Muted text (node path, toggle icon, loading 'more').

baseVariables.name: base-text-color-4
baseVariables.usage: Subtle text (context-menu shortcut, submenu arrow, divider label).

baseVariables.name: base-text-color-on-accent
baseVariables.usage: Text on accent backgrounds — checkbox checkmark color.

baseVariables.name: base-input-bg
baseVariables.usage: Checkbox background (unchecked).

baseVariables.name: base-checkbox-border-color
baseVariables.usage: Unchecked checkbox border — a dedicated stronger mid-gray than base-border-color (ms parity); #8f8f8f fallback.

baseVariables.name: base-checkbox-scale
baseVariables.usage: Shared checkbox BOX scale (default 1). Applied to the box via calc (NOT a CSS transform) so the masked tick/dash stays crisp. See base-css-variables 'Checkbox render method'.

baseVariables.name: base-dropdown-bg
baseVariables.usage: Context-menu and submenu background.

baseVariables.name: base-dropdown-box-shadow
baseVariables.usage: Context-menu shadow.

baseVariables.name: base-font-family
baseVariables.usage: All text in component.

baseVariables.name: base-font-size-xs
baseVariables.usage: Small text — node path, context-menu shortcut, icon font-size (multiplier × --stv-rem).

baseVariables.name: base-font-size-sm
baseVariables.usage: Default node text and context-menu items (multiplier × --stv-rem).

baseVariables.name: base-font-weight-medium
baseVariables.usage: Node label weight.

baseVariables.name: base-border-radius-sm
baseVariables.usage: Checkbox, context-menu, node-content border radius (multiplier × --stv-rem).

baseVariables.name: base-ease-standard
baseVariables.usage: Shared easing curve (ms --ms-easing-snappy parity) — node/checkbox/toggle transitions. cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) fallback.

baseVariables.name: base-icon-chevron
baseVariables.usage: Disclosure glyph for the default `icon-set` (chevron). Chained by --stv-icon-expand; override to reskin the toggle.

baseVariables.name: base-icon-caret-down
baseVariables.usage: Disclosure glyph for `icon-set='triangle'` (filled caret).

baseVariables.name: base-icon-expand
baseVariables.usage: Expand glyph (plus) for `icon-set='plus-minus'`.

baseVariables.name: base-icon-collapse
baseVariables.usage: Collapse glyph (minus) for `icon-set='plus-minus'`.

baseVariables.name: base-icon-check
baseVariables.usage: Checkbox checkmark glyph; chained by --stv-icon-check; inline Lucide SVG fallback.

baseVariables.name: base-icon-indeterminate
baseVariables.usage: Tri-state (partial) checkbox dash glyph; chained by --stv-icon-indeterminate; inline Lucide SVG fallback.

baseVariables.name: base-icon-check-size
baseVariables.usage: mask-size of the check/dash glyph inside the checkbox box (ms/pure-admin shared knob); 68% fallback.

componentVariables.name: stv-rem
componentVariables.usage: Base sizing unit for proportional scaling (bridges --base-rem; default 10px). Set --base-rem to 1rem to scale with document font-size.

componentVariables.name: stv-accent-color
componentVariables.usage: Primary accent (selection, checked checkbox, focus, drop). Chains --base-accent-color. Tints derived via color-mix().

componentVariables.name: stv-text-color-1
componentVariables.usage: Primary body text (node labels, menu items). Chains --base-text-color-1.

componentVariables.name: stv-text-color-2
componentVariables.usage: Secondary text tier (reserved; exposed for cross-component parity).

componentVariables.name: stv-text-color-3
componentVariables.usage: Muted text (node path, toggle icon, loading). Chains --base-text-color-3.

componentVariables.name: stv-text-color-on-accent
componentVariables.usage: Text/glyph on accent backgrounds — checkbox checkmark. Chains --base-text-color-on-accent.

componentVariables.name: stv-danger
componentVariables.usage: Danger hue (drop-invalid, scroll-highlight arrows, danger menu items)

componentVariables.name: stv-bg
componentVariables.usage: Tree surface + color-mix base for the neutral hover. Chains --base-main-bg.

componentVariables.name: stv-elevated-bg
componentVariables.usage: Elevated surface used as the default context-menu background (chains through --base-elevated-bg).

componentVariables.name: stv-light
componentVariables.usage: Elevated chip / debug-stat surface. Light-dark-aware via fallback chain.

componentVariables.name: stv-primary-bg
componentVariables.usage: NEUTRAL text-tinted hover surface (ms --ms-primary-bg parity) — rows + menu items. Chains --base-hover-bg; NOT an accent tint.

componentVariables.name: stv-transition-normal
componentVariables.usage: Normal transition duration (200ms) — row background, toggle rotation.

componentVariables.name: stv-ease-standard
componentVariables.usage: Shared easing curve. Chains --base-ease-standard; cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) fallback.

componentVariables.name: stv-font-family
componentVariables.usage: Font family for all tree text

componentVariables.name: stv-node-icon-margin-right
componentVariables.usage: Gap between node icon and label

componentVariables.name: stv-node-content-padding
componentVariables.usage: Inner padding of a node row

componentVariables.name: stv-children-margin-top
componentVariables.usage: Top margin of nested child list

componentVariables.name: stv-toggle-icon-size
componentVariables.usage: Toggle icon (chevron / +/- / arrow / leaf) SVG size

componentVariables.name: stv-toggle-icon-width
componentVariables.usage: Width reserved for the toggle column

componentVariables.name: stv-toggle-icon-margin-right
componentVariables.usage: Gap between toggle and node content

componentVariables.name: stv-icon-expand
componentVariables.usage: Disclosure glyph shown collapsed (and the only glyph in rotate mode). Re-pointed per `icon-set`; chains to --base-icon-chevron by default.

componentVariables.name: stv-icon-collapse
componentVariables.usage: Disclosure glyph shown when expanded — only consulted in swap mode / plus-minus set.

componentVariables.name: stv-icon-leaf
componentVariables.usage: Optional leaf marker glyph (leaf dot disabled by default in toggle-icons.css).

componentVariables.name: stv-icon-rotate-collapsed
componentVariables.usage: Rotation of the disclosure glyph when collapsed (per icon-set; e.g. -90deg for the down-caret triangle).

componentVariables.name: stv-icon-rotate-expanded
componentVariables.usage: Rotation of the disclosure glyph when expanded (per icon-set; 90deg for chevron/arrow, 0deg for triangle).

componentVariables.name: stv-icon-size-glyph
componentVariables.usage: Mask box for the disclosure glyph (default 1em; scales with the toggle column font-size).

componentVariables.name: stv-icon-check
componentVariables.usage: Checkbox checkmark glyph (mask) for a checked box; chains to --base-icon-check.

componentVariables.name: stv-icon-indeterminate
componentVariables.usage: Dash glyph (mask) for a tri-state/partial checkbox; chains to --base-icon-indeterminate.

componentVariables.name: stv-icon-check-size
componentVariables.usage: mask-size of the check/dash glyph inside the checkbox box. Chains --base-icon-check-size (shared with ms/pure-admin); 68% fallback.

componentVariables.name: stv-checkbox-scale
componentVariables.usage: Checkbox box scale (chains --base-checkbox-scale; multiplies box width/height via calc, no transform)

componentVariables.name: stv-checkbox-border-width
componentVariables.usage: Checkbox border thickness (hairline, does not scale)

componentVariables.name: stv-checkbox-checked-bg-hover
componentVariables.usage: Checked/indeterminate checkbox hover background (accent hover step; ms parity)

componentVariables.name: stv-checkbox-focus-ring-color
componentVariables.usage: Focus-visible ring color (defaults to a 25% tint of --stv-primary)

componentVariables.name: stv-checkbox-focus-ring
componentVariables.usage: Composed focus-visible box-shadow (uses the two parts above; override directly for full control)

componentVariables.name: stv-drop-glow-size
componentVariables.usage: Glow border thickness (hairline, does not scale)

componentVariables.name: stv-drop-arrow-size
componentVariables.usage: Direction arrow size in glow mode

componentVariables.name: stv-drop-arrow-position
componentVariables.usage: Horizontal arrow position (% of node width)

componentVariables.name: stv-drop-arrow-child-rotation
componentVariables.usage: Arrow rotation for 'child' position (45deg by default)

componentVariables.name: stv-drop-arrow-before-image
componentVariables.usage: SVG data URL for the 'before' direction arrow

componentVariables.name: stv-drop-arrow-after-image
componentVariables.usage: SVG data URL for the 'after' direction arrow

componentVariables.name: stv-drop-arrow-child-image
componentVariables.usage: SVG data URL for the 'child' direction arrow

componentVariables.name: tree-ghost-bg
componentVariables.usage: Touch drag ghost background (legacy prefix, kept for backward compat)

componentVariables.name: tree-ghost-color
componentVariables.usage: Touch drag ghost text color (legacy prefix)

componentVariables.name: tree-ghost-shadow
componentVariables.usage: Touch drag ghost drop shadow (legacy prefix)
